name: Hinomiya Kaito
source:
"All right! I can handle it!"

He has a bright and energetic personality that lets him get along with everyone. He hates crooked things and has a strong sense of justice. However, he can also be stubborn and refuse to give up when he is not accepted.

He is a childhood friend of Mika and Niki, and often spends time with Mika. He shares a dorm room with Arata, who views him as a rival for some reason.

Sign: Aries
Likes: Omurice, soccer
Dislikes: Dogs
Power: Fire

[Translated from [url=http://dearmagi.caerux.com/character/]official website[/url]]
